item.title: Democratic Party: “Even One More Seat” vs. People Power: “Defend Yeongnam”… Regional Governor Race Lineups Finalized (민주 “1곳이라도 더” vs 국힘 “영남 수성”…광역단체장 대진표 확정)
item.description:
The lineup for the 16 regional governor races in the June 3 local elections was finalized on the 2nd after the People Power Party nominated Yang Hyang-ja as its Gyeonggi Province governor candidate. (6·3 지방선거 광역단체장 16곳의 대진표가 지난 2일 국민의힘이 양향자 최고위원을 경기지사 후보로 공천하며 최종 확정됐다.)

The Democratic Party, which suffered a crushing defeat in the local elections four years ago, is aiming for a landslide victory by fielding heavyweights, including former district office heads and ex-presidential office officials, led by Seoul mayoral candidate Jung Won-oh, Daegu mayoral candidate Kim Boo-kyum, and Gangwon governor candidate Woo Sang-ho. Amid internal strife under the far-right leanings of leader Jang Dong-hyuk, the People Power Party, facing a shortage of strong candidates, has nominated incumbent regional governors in 11 seats and is focusing on defending them. (4년 전 지방선거에서 참패했던 더불어민주당은 정원오 서울시장 후보를 필두로 김부겸 대구시장 후보, 우상호 강원지사 후보 등 구청장 출신을 포함해 청와대 출신이나 중량감 있는 인물을 내세워 압승을 노린다. 장동혁 대표의 극우 행보 속에 내홍 중인 국민의힘은 인물난 속에 11곳에서 현역 광역단체장을 공천하며 수성에 나서고 있다.)

Based on President Lee Jae-myung’s high approval rating of around the mid-60%, the Democratic Party aims not only to reclaim the 12 regional governor seats won by the People Power Party in the 2022 local elections but also to win seats in Yeongnam regions, including Busan, Ulsan, South Gyeongsang, and Daegu. The Democratic Party emphasizes that its candidates in Yeongnam are “powerful figures” backed by the full support of the ruling party. However, it is wary of excessive optimism. Secretary-General Jo Seung-rae told *The Hankyoreh* on the 3rd, “We are not setting standards for victory or defeat. Our goal is to do our best to win even one more seat without creating internal variables.” (민주당은 60%대 중반에 이르는 이재명 대통령의 높은 지지율을 바탕으로 2022년 지방선거에서 국민의힘이 승리한 12곳의 광역단체장 탈환은 물론, 부·울·경과 대구 등 영남 지역 광역단체장 당선까지 목표로 삼고 있다. 민주당은 영남권에서 집권여당의 전폭적인 지원을 등에 업은 ‘힘 있는 후보’라는 점을 부각한다. 다만 지나친 낙관론은 경계하고 있다. 조승래 사무총장은 3일 한겨레에 “승패의 기준은 생각하고 있지 않다. 내부 변수를 만들지 않고 한곳이라도 더 이기기 위해 최선을 다하는 게 목표”라고 했다.)

The People Power Party claims its goal is to hold onto incumbent regional governors, but realistically, assessments both inside and outside the party suggest that defending Yeongnam—including Daegu, Busan, Ulsan, and South Gyeongsang—would be a satisfactory outcome. In Seoul, where candidate Oh Se-hoon faces Democratic candidate Jung Won-oh, a late surge is anticipated. Secretary-General Jeong Hee-yong told *The Hankyoreh*, “Our primary goal is to defend incumbent governors. While there is no region where we are not in a tight race now, the stability and preparedness of our incumbents will bring about a major turnaround.” The People Power Party expects a late consolidation of support in Daegu, Busan, Ulsan, and South Gyeongsang. In particular, it hopes that the special counsel investigation into alleged manipulated prosecutions, proposed by the Democratic Party, will galvanize conservative voters and change the election dynamics. (국민의힘은 현역 광역단체장 사수를 목표로 내세우지만, 현실적으로 대구와 부·울·경 등 영남을 사수하면 선방이라는 평가가 당 안팎에서 나온다. 오세훈 후보가 정원오 민주당 후보와 맞붙는 서울은 막판 추격을 기대한다. 정희용 사무총장은 한겨레에 “현역 단체장 사수가 1차 목표다. 우리로서는 현재 접전이 아닌 지역이 없지만, 현역의 안정감과 준비된 모습이 대반전을 이뤄낼 것”이라고 했다. 국민의힘은 대구, 부·울·경의 막판 결집을 기대한다. 특히 민주당이 발의한 조작기소 특검법이 보수 결집을 자극해 선거 판세를 바꾸길 바란다.)

The Democratic Party also appears to remain vigilant against “shy conservatives.” A key Democratic leadership official said, “In Seoul, where a (roughly 10%) approval rating gap is maintained, it still looks like a ‘slight advantage,’ but tight races are expected in Busan, Ulsan, South Gyeongsang, and Daegu.” This indicates the party is staying on guard against the “conservative rally” trend. (민주당도 ‘샤이 보수’에 경계를 늦추지 않는 모양이다. 민주당 지도부 핵심 관계자는 “(10%대 안팎의) 지지율 격차를 유지 중인 서울은 아직까지 ‘박빙 우세’로 보이나 부·울·경, 대구는 접전이 예상된다”고 했다. ‘보수 결집’ 흐름에 긴장을 늦추지 않고 있다는 이야기다.)

In a wireless automated response survey commissioned by Daegu MBC and conducted by Ace Research on the 18th and 19th of last month, Democratic candidate Kim Boo-kyum (49.2%) and People Power candidate Choo Kyung-ho (35.1%) showed a 14.1 percentage point gap. However, in a wireless telephone interview survey commissioned by MBC and conducted by Korea Research International on the 28th and 29th of last month, the gap narrowed to 9 percentage points, with Kim at 44% and Choo at 35%. (For details, refer to the National Election Survey Deliberation Commission website.) A campaign official for Kim Boo-kyum said, “The moment people think, ‘Kim Boo-kyum is good, but which party is he from?’ their minds waver. We must push Kim Boo-kyum ahead unconditionally, not the party.” (대구문화방송(MBC)이 에이스리서치에 의뢰해 지난달 18~19일 실시한 무선자동응답조사에서 김부겸 민주당 후보(49.2%)와 추경호 국민의힘 후보(35.1%)는 14.1%포인트 격차를 보였다. 그러나 문화방송이 코리아리서치인터내셔널에 의뢰해 무선전화면접으로 실시한 지난달 28~29일 조사에서는 김 후보 44%, 추 후보 35%로 격차가 9%포인트로 좁혀졌다.(자세한 내용은 중앙선거여론조사심의위원회 누리집 참고) 김 후보 캠프 관계자는 “‘여러분 김부겸은 좋은데, 어느 당입니까’ 하는 순간 마음이 돌아선다. 무조건 당보다 김부겸을 앞세워야 한다”고 했다.)

The People Power Party is pinning its hopes on the consolidation of conservative voters who turned away after the December 3 martial law declaration. A People Power official said, “Among traditional conservative supporters who said they would punish the party by not going to the polls because they are sick of the nomination infighting, voices saying, ‘At least in Daegu, we must protect conservatism’ are gaining strength as the election approaches.” (국민의힘은 12·3 비상계엄 뒤 등 돌린 보수 유권자들의 결집에 희망을 건다. 국민의힘의 한 관계자는 “공천 내홍으로 꼴도 보기 싫다고 투표장에 나가지 않는 방식으로 심판한다고 했던 전통 보수 지지층 사이에서 그래도 대구에서만큼은 보수를 지켜야 하는 것 아니냐는 목소리가 선거가 임박하면 할수록 힘을 받게 될 것”이라고 했다.)

In the Busan mayoral race between Democratic candidate Jeon Jae-soo and People Power candidate Park Hyung-joon, the South Gyeongsang governor race between Democratic candidate Kim Kyung-soo and People Power candidate Park Wan-soo, and the Ulsan mayoral race between Democratic candidate Kim Sang-wook and People Power candidate Kim Doo-kyum, all feature a “candidate backed by the ruling party premium” versus an “incumbent mayor” dynamic. A Democratic leadership lawmaker said, “In areas with strong conservative tendencies, based on past experience, a gap of at least 15 percentage points in polls is needed to feel safe. The current gap of around 10 percentage points is precarious and could be overturned at any time in the main election.” (전재수 민주당 후보와 박형준 국민의힘 후보가 맞붙은 부산시장 선거와, 김경수 민주당 후보와 박완수 국민의힘 후보가 경쟁하는 경남지사 선거, 김상욱 민주당 후보와 김두겸 국민의힘 후보가 경쟁하는 울산시장 선거는 모두 ‘집권여당 프리미엄을 업은 후보’와 ‘현역 시장 후보’ 간의 대결 구도다. 민주당 지도부의 한 의원은 “보수세가 강한 곳은 과거 경험상 여론조사에서 적어도 15%포인트 이상 격차를 벌려놓아야 안심할 수 있다”며 “현재의 10%포인트 안팎의 차이는 본선에서 언제든 뒤집히는 위태로운 수치”라고 했다.)

Other variables include candidate gaffes, the Democratic Party’s push for a special counsel on alleged manipulated investigations and prosecutions, sentiment in the Seoul metropolitan area real estate market, and voter turnout. Jeong Han-wool, head of the Korea People Research Institute, said, “If issues that could galvanize the ‘conservative defectors’ (due to the December 3 martial law) come to the fore, rather than the Lee Jae-myung administration’s so-far demonstrated ‘people-first’ and ‘integration’ stance, it could affect the Yeongnam region.” (후보자의 설화, 민주당의 조작 수사·기소 특검 추진, 수도권 부동산 민심, 투표율 등도 또 다른 변수다. 정한울 한국사람연구원장은 “지금까지 보여준 이재명 정부의 ‘민생 우선’ ‘통합’ 기조보다, (12·3 비상계엄에 따른) ‘이탈 보수’들을 자극할 수 있는 이슈가 부각되면 영남 지역에서 영향을 받을 것”이라고 했다.)

Reporter Go Han-sol sol@hani.co.kr Reporter Jang Na-rae wing@hani.co.kr (고한솔 기자 sol@hani.co.kr 장나래 기자 wing@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Jeong Cheong-rae says "Call him oppa," drawing criticism from opposition: "I apologize to the child and parents"… Opposition says "Inappropriate" (“오빠 해봐요” 발언 정청래, “아이와 부모께 송구”…야권 “부적절”)
item.description:
A video circulated online on the 3rd showing Jeong Cheong-rae, leader of the Democratic Party of Korea, telling a first-grade elementary school girl to call Ha Jung-woo, the Democratic Party candidate for the Busan North-Gap by-election, "oppa" (older brother) during a campaign event in Busan, sparking fierce criticism from the opposition. As the controversy grew, Leader Jeong issued a statement saying, "I apologize to the child, who has been hurt by being at the center of this controversy, and to the child's parents." (정청래 더불어민주당 대표가 부산에서 선거 운동 중에 초등학교 1학년 여학생에게 하정우 민주당 부산 북갑 국회의원 보궐선거 후보를 ‘오빠’라고 부르라고 한 영상이 3일 온라인에서 확산하자 야권에서 맹비난이 쏟아졌다. 논란이 확산되자 정 대표는 “아이가 논란의 중심에 서게 되어 상처받으셨을 아이와 아이의 부모님께 송구한다”는 입장을 밝혔다. )

In the video, Leader Jeong, while campaigning for Candidate Ha at Gupo Market in Busan, said to a child, "What grade are you in? Here, Jeong-woo oppa, say oppa." When the child replied, "I’m in first grade," Leader Jeong repeated, "Here, Jeong-woo oppa," and Candidate Ha also responded with "Oppa." After the child said "Oppa," they took a commemorative photo. According to Democratic Party attendees at the scene, the child’s mother and family did not appear uncomfortable, and the atmosphere was friendly. (영상을 보면, 이날 정 대표는 부산 구포시장에서 하 후보 지원 유세를 하던 중 한 어린이에게 “몇 학년이에요? 여기 정우 오빠, 오빠 해봐요”라고 말했다. 어린이가 “1학년이에요”라고 답하자, 정 대표가 “여기 정우 오빠”라고 말했고 하 후보도 “오빠”라고 반응했다. 이후 어린이가 “오빠”라고 말한 뒤 이들은 기념사진을 찍었다. 이에 대해 당시 어린이의 어머니 등 가족이 불편해하지 않았고, 우호적인 분위기였다는 게 민주당 현장 참석자들의 설명이다.)

However, the opposition criticized the attitude of Leader Jeong and Candidate Ha toward the child as inappropriate. Seong Il-jong, a member of the People Power Party, wrote on Facebook, "The two of them repeatedly urging a hesitant child to say 'oppa' back and forth is essentially a form of child abuse. How uncomfortable must that child have been, forced to reluctantly say 'oppa'?" Park Min-sik, the People Power Party candidate running in Busan North-Gap, wrote on Facebook, "Is this what you’d expect from a politician who came to check on people’s livelihoods?" Independent candidate Han Dong-hoon also criticized, saying, "Would it be okay if your own young child was surrounded by two men in their 50s and 60s, seeing them for the first time, and subjected to such behavior?" <<> That evening, Leader Jeong issued a statement through the Democratic Party’s Public Relations Office, saying, "Regarding the situation during the visit to Gupo Market, I apologize to the child, who has been hurt by being at the center of this controversy, and to the child’s parents." (하지만 야권은 어린이를 대하는 정 대표와 하 후보의 태도가 부적절했다는 비판을 잇달아 내놨다. 성일종 국민의힘 의원은 페이스북에 “망설이는 아이에게 두 사람이 번갈아 가며 재차 ‘오빠라고 해보라’고 재촉하는 모습은 일종의 아동 학대나 다름없다”며 “마지못해 ‘오빠’라고 불러야 했던 저 아이가 얼마나 불편했을까요”라고 썼다. 부산 북갑에 출마한 국민의힘 소속 박민식 후보는 페이스북에 “이게 민생을 살피러 온 정치인의 입에서 나올 소리이냐”고, 무소속 한동훈 후보도 “(정 대표와 하 후보는) 어린 자녀가 처음 보는 50대, 60대 남성 둘에게 둘러싸여 저런 행동 당해도 괜찮습니까”라고 비판했다.)

Previously, on the 29th of last month, a video spread showing Candidate Ha appearing to shake his hand after shaking hands with merchants during a campaign at Gupo Market, sparking controversy. At the time, Candidate Ha said, "After shaking hands with nearly 1,000 people a day, my hand went numb, and it was an unconscious movement," while the People Power Party criticized him for showing a dismissive attitude toward citizens. ( 이날 밤 정 대표는 민주당 공보국을 통해 “구포시장 방문 과정의 상황과 관련하여 아이가 논란의 중심에 서게 되어 상처받으셨을 아이와 아이의 부모님께 송구합니다”라는 입장을 밝혔다.)

Choi Ha-yan, Reporter chy@hani.co.kr (앞서 지난달 29일 하 후보가 구포시장 유세 중 상인들과 악수한 뒤 손을 터는 듯한 영상이 확산해 논란이 된 바 있다. 당시 하 후보는 “하루 1천명 가까이 악수하다 보니 손이 저려 무의식중에 나온 동작”이라고 했고, 국민의힘은 하 후보가 시민들을 무시하는 태도를 보인 것이라고 비판했다.)

item.title: Innovation Party: "Zero for People Power" | Progressive Party: "Triple the Winners" | Reform Party: "Produce a Metropolitan Mayor" (혁신당 “국힘 제로” 진보당 “당선자 3배” 개혁신당 “광역단체장 배출”)
item.description:
<<>> Candidates from minor parties challenging the June 3 local elections are making all-out efforts to achieve meaningful results amidst the dominant two-party structure of the Democratic Party of Korea and the People Power Party. ()

As of the 3rd, the Fatherland Innovation Party has confirmed candidates for one metropolitan mayor position (Ulsan) and 22 basic local government heads in the Honam region; the Progressive Party has confirmed candidates for 7 metropolitan mayors and 20 basic local government heads; and the Reform Party has confirmed candidates for 7 metropolitan mayors and 18 basic local government heads. (6·3 지방선거에 도전하는 소수정당 소속 후보들은 더불어민주당·국민의힘 양당 구도 사이에서 유의미한 성과를 내기 위해 총력을 기울이고 있다.)

The Innovation Party is preparing for the local elections with three goals: "Zero for People Power" (zero People Power Party winners), "Zero Corruption" (eradicating corruption in nominations and bribery), and "Launching a Social Rights Advanced Country." Senior Spokesperson Park Byung-eon of the Innovation Party met with reporters at the National Assembly that day and said, "We have three specific targets: to be reborn as a nationwide party with metropolitan council members in every metropolitan autonomous region, to increase the number of basic local government heads (from the current 1), and to bring Representative Cho (the candidate for the by-election in Pyeongtaek B, Gyeonggi) into the National Assembly." <<> The Progressive Party has set its goals as winning the Pyeongtaek B National Assembly by-election for Co-Chairperson Kim Jae-yeon, winning the Ulsan mayoral election for candidate Kim Jong-hoon, and tripling the number of winners compared to the previous local elections. Progressive Party Secretary-General Shin Chang-hyun said, "In the last election, 21 people were elected, but this time, I think we can get more than triple that number. We are expecting at least three basic local government heads, mainly in the Honam and Ulsan regions, and over 10 seats in metropolitan councils. Our goal is to become the third party (in terms of the number of local election winners)." However, a variable for both the Innovation Party and the Progressive Party is the pending discussions on unification, including with the Democratic Party, in the Pyeongtaek B by-election, where their party leaders are running, and the Ulsan mayoral election, where their key candidates are running. <<> The Reform Party's goal is "to elect at least one metropolitan mayor as a realistic target, and in Gyeonggi Province, to produce basic council members in all 31 cities and counties." Previously, Representative Lee Jun-seok gained attention by proposing a "990,000 won election" for basic council candidates, essentially not collecting deposits of millions of won from them and allowing them to run at minimal cost. They also have an "AI Manager" that uses artificial intelligence to plan campaign routes and provide election law consultation. <<> Among non-parliamentary party and independent candidates, some are drawing attention. Kwon Young-guk, the leader of the Justice Party who ran for president in the last election, has thrown his hat into the ring for Seoul mayor. Former Democratic Party lawmaker Son Hye-won is running as an independent in the Mokpo City Council election in South Jeolla Province. <<> Reporter Kim Chae-woon cwk@hani.co.kr Reporter Yoo Young-jae young@hani.co.kr ( 3일 기준 조국혁신당은 광역단체장 1곳(울산)과 호남 지역 기초단체장 22곳, 진보당은 광역단체장 7곳과 기초단체장 20곳, 개혁신당은 광역단체장 7곳과 기초단체장 18곳의 후보를 확정한 상태다.)

item.title: By-elections: Democratic Party leads in 8 districts, People Power in 2… ‘Unification’ in Busan Namsa and Pyeongtaek-eul is the biggest variable (재보궐 민주 8곳·국힘 2곳 우위…부산북갑·평택을 ‘단일화’ 최대변수)
item.description:
<<>> On the day of the June 3 local elections, by-elections for National Assembly seats will also be held in 14 constituencies nationwide. This is twice the number of by-elections (7) held alongside the June 1 local elections four years ago, making the term ‘mini general election’ fitting. Except for the Daegu Dalseong by-election, all 13 other constituencies were previously represented by Democratic Party lawmakers. Key points of interest include: the outcomes for heavyweight figures such as former Democratic Party leader Song Young-gil, former People Power Party leader Han Dong-hoon, and former Justice Party leader Cho Kuk; last-minute unification deals in competitive districts; and whether former aides to President Lee Jae-myung will return to office. ()

A compilation of by-election analyses from both parties and polls, gathered by *The Hankyoreh* on the 3rd, suggests that the Democratic Party is leading in 8 of the 14 by-elections, while the People Power Party leads in 2. The Democratic Party holds an advantage in three metropolitan area districts (Incheon Gyeyang-eul, Yeonsu-gap, and Gyeonggi Ansan-gap), three Honam region districts (Gwangju Gwangsan-eul, Jeonbuk Gunsan·Gimje·Buan-gap, and Gunsan·Gimje·Buan-eul), Chungnam Asan-eul, and Jeju Seogwipo. The People Power Party is seen as leading in Daegu Dalseong and Ulsan Nam-gap. (6·3 지방선거 당일에는 전국 14곳에서 국회의원 재보궐선거도 함께 치러진다. 이는 4년 전 6·1 지방선거와 함께 치러진 국회의원 재보궐선거 7곳보다 2배가 많은 것으로 ‘미니 총선’이라는 수식이 어색하지 않다. 대구 달성 보궐선거를 빼곤 13곳 모두 더불어민주당 의원의 지역구였던 곳이다. △송영길 더불어민주당 전 대표, 한동훈 전 국민의힘 대표, 조국 조국혁신당 대표 등 중량감 있는 인사들의 당락 △접전 지역 여야의 막판 단일화 △이재명 대통령 참모 출신들의 생환 여부 등이 관심을 모은다.)

Among these, Busan Buk-gap is considered the most intense battleground by both parties. It is a three-way race between Democratic Party candidate Ha Jung-woo, People Power Party candidate Park Min-shik, and independent candidate Han Dong-hoon. ( 한겨레가 3일 취재한 여야 정당과 여론조사 결과를 모아 분석한 결과 14곳의 재보궐선거에서 민주당은 8곳, 국민의힘은 2곳에서 우위를 보인다. 민주당은 수도권 3곳(인천 계양을·연수갑, 경기 안산갑)과 호남권 3곳(광주 광산을, 전북 군산·김제 부안갑, 군산·김제·부안을), 충남 아산을, 제주 서귀포에서, 국민의힘은 대구 달성과 울산 남갑에서 우세하다고 본다.)

Interest in this district has surged with the nomination of political newcomer Ha Jung-woo, a former presidential senior secretary for AI and future planning. Recent polls show that the combined support for Han and Park sometimes surpasses Ha’s. According to a KBS Busan-Korea Research poll released on the 1st (conducted April 27-28 via telephone interviews), Ha received 29%, Han 23%, Park 22%, and People Power Party candidate Lee Young-pung (former KBS reporter) 1%. (For details, refer to the National Election Survey Deliberation Commission website). The People Power Party will hold a primary on the 5th to select a final candidate between Park and Lee. ( 이 가운데 부산 북갑은 여야 모두 최대 격전지로 꼽는 곳이다. 민주당 하정우, 국민의힘 박민식, 무소속 한동훈 후보가 경쟁하는 3자 구도다.)

As a result, analysts suggest that a unification between Han and the People Power Party candidate could be a key variable in determining the election outcome. ( 이곳은 청와대 에이아이(AI)미래기획 수석을 지낸 ‘정치 신인’ 하정우 후보가 공천받으면서 관심도가 급상승했다. 최근 여론조사에서는 한 후보와 박 후보 지지율 단순 합산 수치가 하 후보를 넘는 경우가 나오고 있다. 지난 1일 공개된 ‘한국방송’(KBS) 부산총국-한국리서치 여론조사 결과(4월27~28일·전화면접조사)를 보면 하 후보가 29%, 한 후보가 23%, 박 후보가 22%, 국민의힘 이영풍 후보(KBS 전 기자)가 1%로 나타난다.(자세한 내용은 중앙선거여론조사심의위원회 누리집 참고) 국민의힘은 5일 경선을 거쳐 박 후보와 이 후보 가운데 한명을 최종 후보로 확정한다.)

A People Power Party lawmaker from the Yeongnam region said, “While some support may be lost during the unification process, it’s crucial for the divided conservative base to come together.” However, the Democratic Party downplayed potential synergy effects. A Democratic Party official remarked, “Park Min-shik’s supporters have a strong anti-Han Dong-hoon sentiment, while Han Dong-hoon’s supporters are generally disappointed with the People Power Party. These divergent votes could be dispersed and ultimately go to Ha Jung-woo.” ( 이 때문에 한 후보와 국민의힘 후보 사이의 단일화가 판세를 가를 변수라는 분석이 나온다.)

The five-way race in Gyeonggi Pyeongtaek-eul is unpredictable. Candidates include Democratic Party’s Kim Yong-nam, People Power Party’s Yoo Eui-dong, Justice Party’s Cho Kuk, Progressive Party’s Kim Jae-yeon, and Liberty Innovation Party’s Hwang Kyo-ahn, representing both conservative and progressive blocs. In particular, the Justice Party is concentrating its resources here, as Cho Kuk’s outcome is directly tied to the party’s fate. While Kim Yong-nam, Cho Kuk, and Yoo Eui-dong are seen as frontrunners, there is no clear leader. Here, too, unification among progressive candidates (Kim Yong-nam, Cho Kuk, Kim Jae-yeon) and conservative candidates (Yoo Eui-dong, Hwang Kyo-ahn) remains a variable. ( 영남권 국민의힘 의원은 “단일화 과정에서 일부 지지층 이탈은 있겠지만, 분열된 보수 지지층이 뭉치는 게 중요하다”고 말했다. 그러나 민주당 쪽은 시너지 효과를 평가절하했다. 한 민주당 관계자는 “박민식 후보 쪽 지지층은 한동훈 후보 비토 정서가 크고, 반대로 한동훈 후보 지지층은 국민의힘에 실망한 그룹”이라며 “교집합이 없는 표들이 분산돼 하정우 후보에게 갈 수 있다”고 말했다.)

Gyeonggi Hanam-gap is also a competitive district. This is the former district of Democratic Party lawmaker Choo Mi-ae, who vacated the seat after being elected as the party’s candidate for Gyeonggi governor. (5자 구도인 경기 평택을은 예측 불가다. 민주당 김용남, 국민의힘 유의동, 조국혁신당 조국, 진보당 김재연, 자유와혁신 황교안 후보 등 보수와 진보 후보들이 저마다 경쟁하고 있다. 특히 조국혁신당은 이곳에 당력을 집중하고 있다. 조 후보의 당락이 곧 당의 명운과 직결되기 때문이다. 이런 가운데 김용남·조국·유의동 후보 등 3명이 앞서는 것으로 보이나 아직 독보적인 1위는 없는 상황이다. 이곳 역시 진보 계열인 김용남-조국-김재연 후보와 보수 계열인 유의동-황교안 후보 간의 단일화가 변수다.)

In the 2024 22nd general election, where the Democratic Party achieved a landslide victory, Choo narrowly won this district by just 1,199 votes against then-People Power Party candidate Lee Yong. This is why the Democratic Party fielded Lee Kwang-jae, who showed strength in the conservative-leaning Gyeonggi Seongnam Bundang-gap. For the People Power Party, Lee Yong—who served as President Yoon Seok-youl’s campaign chief in the 2022 presidential election and was nicknamed “the bodyguard”—was nominated amid controversy over a “Yoon Again” narrative. ( 경기 하남갑도 접전지다. 이곳은 추미애 민주당 의원의 지역구로 추 의원이 경기지사 후보에 선출되면서 보궐선거가 생겼다.)

Chungnam Gongju·Buyeo·Cheongyang is also considered a key battleground. This was the former district of Democratic Party’s Chungnam Governor candidate Park Soo-hyun. The Democratic Party is considering former Buyeo County mayor Park Jeong-hyun, a three-term mayor. From the People Power Party, former lawmaker Chung Jin-suk—a five-term representative from the region and former chief of staff to President Yoon—has expressed his intention to run. The People Power Party will discuss Chung’s nomination on the 4th. A Democratic Party lawmaker from Chungcheong said, “If Jeong gets the nomination, it creates a dynamic of ‘insurrection forces versus anti-insurrection forces,’ which wouldn’t be bad for us.” A second-term People Power Party lawmaker added, “We need to assess Jeong’s competitiveness first, but it’s worrying that the local election landscape in Chungcheong is shifting against us.” ( 민주당이 대승한 2024년 22대 총선에서 추 후보는 이곳에서 이용 당시 국민의힘 후보에게 1199표차로 신승했다. 민주당이 보수세가 강한 경기 성남 분당갑에서 저력을 보인 이광재 후보를 투입한 배경이다. 국민의힘에선 2022년 대선 때 윤석열 대통령 후보 수행실장을 맡아 ‘호위무사’로 불린 이용 후보가 ‘윤 어게인 논란’ 속에 공천됐다.)

Meanwhile, attention is also focused on whether former presidential aides, including Ha Jung-woo (Busan Buk-gap), Kim Nam-joon (Incheon Gyeyang-eul), Kim Nam-kook (Gyeonggi Ansan-gap), and Jeon Eun-soo (Chungnam Asan-eul), will return to the National Assembly. The outcome for former Democratic Party leader Song Young-gil (Incheon Yeonsu-gap) could influence the party’s leadership race at the August convention, making it a key point of observation. ( 충남 공주·부여·청양도 승부처로 꼽힌다. 이곳은 박수현 민주당 충남지사 후보의 지역구였다. 민주당에선 3선 부여군수를 지낸 박정현 전 군수가 후보로 거론된다. 국민의힘에서는 이 지역에서 5선을 한 윤석열 전 대통령 마지막 비서실장 출신 정진석 전 의원이 출마 의사를 밝혔다. 국민의힘은 정 전 의원의 공천 여부를 4일 논의한다. 충청권 민주당 의원은 “(정 전 의원이 국민의힘 공천을 받으면) 내란 세력 대 내란 극복 세력 구도가 만들어져 나쁠 게 없어 보인다”고 말했다. 국민의힘 재선 의원은 “일단 (정 전 의원의) 경쟁력을 봐야 하지 않겠냐”면서도 “충청 지역 지방선거 판세가 밀리고 있어 걱정은 된다”고 했다.)

For the People Power Party, the focus is on whether “Yoon Again” figures—including Lee Yong, Lee Jin-sook (Daegu Dalseong), and Kim Tae-kyu (Ulsan Nam-gap)—will enter the National Assembly. The Democratic Party has made this a campaign issue, arguing that “the People Power Party’s nominations have ultimately resulted in a ‘Yoon Again’ lineup.” ( 이런 가운데 민주당의 하정우 후보를 포함해 김남준(인천 계양을), 김남국(경기 안산갑), 전은수(충남 아산을) 후보 등 청와대 참모들의 생환 여부도 관심을 모은다. 송영길(인천 연수갑) 전 대표의 당선 여부는 8월 민주당 전당대회 당권 구도에 영향을 미칠 수 있어 관전 포인트다.)

Shim Woo-sam, reporter: wu32@hani.co.kr Kim Hae-jeong: sea@hani.co.kr ( 국민의힘에서는 이용 후보를 비롯해 이진숙(대구 달성), 김태규(울산 남갑) 후보 등 이른바 윤 어게인 인사들의 여의도 입성 여부가 주목된다. 민주당은 이들에 대해 “국민의힘 공천이 결국 윤 어게인 공천으로 귀결됐다”고 재보궐선거 쟁점으로 삼고 있다. )

item.title: People Power Party's 'Chung Jin-suk Nomination' Buzz Draws Criticism: Park Ji-won Says "Focus on Supporting Yoon Seok-youl in Prison" (국힘 ‘정진석 공천설’에 박지원 “윤석열 옥바라지나 열심히 하라”)
item.description:
Amid the People Power Party's rumored nomination of former lawmaker Chung Jin-suk, who served as Chief of Staff to former President Yoon Seok-youl during the December 3 martial law declaration, Yang Hyang-ja, the party's candidate for Gyeonggi Province governor, indirectly criticized the move, questioning "whether it would help the party's overall victory." (12·3 비상계엄 선포 당시 윤석열 전 대통령의 비서실장이던 정진석 전 국민의힘 의원에 대한 국민의힘 ‘공천설’을 두고 양향자 국민의힘 경기지사 후보가 “당의 전체 승리에 도움이 될까”라며 에둘러 비판했다.)

Yang, a member of the PPP's Supreme Council, said on KBS Radio's "Breaking News" on the 4th when asked about the "Chung Jin-suk nomination rumor": "It's really not right for the leadership to be bickering like this again." She added, "But I wonder whether Chief Chung's candidacy would help the party's overall victory. He will face a constant barrage of crossfire from the media—can the party endure that? There's also the question of why we should have to endure it." Yang effectively signaled her opposition to the nomination, saying, "I believe the party will move forward with a grand vision for change and innovation." (국민의힘 최고위원인 양 후보는 4일 한국방송(KBS) 라디오 ‘전격시사’에서 ‘정진석 공천설’에 대한 질문을 받자 “지도부가 또 왈가왈부하는 것이 정말 맞지 않다”면서도 “다만 정 실장 출마가 당의 전체 승리에 도움이 될까. 계속해서 언론의 십자 포화를 맞을 텐데 당이 견딜 수 있을까 이런 생각을 한다. 또 왜 견뎌야 하나 이런 의문도 있다”고 말했다. 양 후보는 “당이 변화와 혁신을 향해서 대승적으로 나서줄 것이라 믿는다”며 사실상 공천에 반대한다는 뜻을 드러냈다.)

Former PPP Emergency Response Committee Chairman Kim Jong-in also said on YTN Radio's "Jang Seong-cheol's News Court" the same day, "I think Chief Chung Jin-suk's ambition is too much." He added, "Putting aside other issues, Chief Chung was, in fact, President Yoon's final chief of staff. With the martial law issue linked to the president being impeached and standing trial, I think it's too hasty for the chief who served the president to immediately say he will run for election again." (김종인 전 국민의힘 비대위원장도 이날 와이티엔(YTN) 라디오 ‘장성철의 뉴스명당’에서 “정진석 실장 욕심이 너무 과하지 않나 생각한다”며 “다른 걸 떠나서 정 실장은 사실 윤 (전) 대통령의 마지막 비서실장이다. 계엄 문제가 연결돼 대통령이 탄핵을 받고, 재판을 받는 상황에서 대통령을 모시던 실장이 그냥 바로 선거에 다시 출마하겠다고 하는 것은 너무 성급하지 않나 생각한다”고 했다.)

Criticism continues from the opposition camp as well. Democratic Party lawmaker Park Ji-won, speaking on SBS Radio's "Kim Tae-hyun's Breaking News" on the same day, directly took aim at former Chief Chung, saying, "Focus on supporting former President Yoon in prison." Park, a former chief of staff to ex-President Kim Dae-jung, criticized, "No matter how much of an insurrection suspect, if the president and first lady you served are in prison, then as chief of staff, the duty is to apologize to the people and at least diligently support them in prison. How can someone have the audacity to say they will run for a National Assembly seat?" (여권의 비판도 계속되고 있다. 박지원 더불어민주당 의원은 이날 에스비에스(SBS) 라디오 ‘김태현의 전격시사’에서 “윤 전 대통령 옥바라지나 열심히 하라”며 정 전 실장을 직격했다. 김대중 전 대통령 비서실장 출신인 박 의원은 “아무리 내란사범이라고 하더라도 자기가 모셨던 대통령 내외분이 감옥에 있으면, 제가 비서실장이라고 하면, 국민에게 사과를 하고 그리고 옥바라지라도 열심히 해주는 게 비서실장의 소임”이라며 “어떻게 자기가 국회의원에 나간다고 하는 그런 뻔뻔한 소리를 할 수 있나”라고 비판했다.)

Earlier, on the 30th of last month, former Chief Chung announced his candidacy for the by-election in Gongju, Buyeo, and Cheongyang, South Chungcheong Province, on Facebook, stating, "I will restore parliamentary democracy and set our camp straight." He described the martial law declaration as "a bolt from the blue for me," but also said, "I have not the slightest intention of severing my personal ties (with former President Yoon)." (앞서 정 전 실장은 지난달 30일 페이스북에서 “국회에서 의회주의를, 우리 진영을 바로 세우겠다”라며 충남 공주·부여·청양 보궐선거 출마 선언을 했다. 그는 “계엄 선포는 제게 마른하늘에 날벼락”이었다면서도 “(윤 전 대통령과) 인간적 관계를 끊을 생각은 추호도 없다”고도 했다.)

The PPP's Nomination Management Committee on the 1st postponed the nomination decision for Gongju, Buyeo, and Cheongyang, where former Chief Chung is running, citing the need for a candidate qualification review by the party's Ethics Committee. However, the Ethics Committee abruptly canceled its scheduled meeting on the 2nd, leaving the Nomination Committee unable to decide on the nomination. (국민의힘 공천관리위원회는 지난 1일 당 윤리위원회의 후보자 자격 심사가 필요하다는 이유로 정 전 실장이 출마한 충남 공주·부여·청양 공천을 보류했다. 하지만 당 윤리위가 2일 예정됐던 회의를 돌연 취소하면서 공관위는 공천 여부를 판단하지 못하고 있다.)

Former Chief Chung is suspected of ordering the initialization of all computers in the presidential office shortly after former President Yoon's impeachment last year, allegedly to destroy evidence related to the December 3 insurrection incident. In connection with this, the National Police Agency's third special investigation unit under the special counsel transferred Chung without detention to the Seoul Central District Prosecutors' Office in February on charges including damage to public electronic records, abuse of authority obstructing the exercise of rights, and violations of the Presidential Records Management Act. (정 전 실장은 지난해 윤 전 대통령 파면 직후 12·3 내란 사태 관련 증거를 인멸하기 위해 대통령실 내 모든 컴퓨터 초기화를 지시한 혐의를 받고 있다. 이와 관련해 경찰청 3대 특검 특별수사본부는 지난 2월 정 전 실장을 공용전자기록 등 손상, 직권남용권리행사방해, 대통령기록물관리법 위반 등 혐의로 서울중앙지검에 불구속 송치했다.)

By Jeon Gwang-jun, Staff Reporter light@hani.co.kr (전광준 기자 light@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Jang Dong-hyuk: "Is President Lee Trying to Become No. 2 Absolute Authority?"... Daily Criticism of Special Counsel Act (장동혁 “이 대통령, 최고존엄 넘버2 되려는가”…연일 특검법 비판)
item.description:

item.title: Chung Cheong-rae Repeatedly Apologizes for 'Try Calling Me Oppa' Remark... Even Within Party, "Leader's Gaffe" (정청래 ‘오빠 해봐요’ 발언 거듭 사과…당내서도 “대표가 실언을”)
item.description:
Chung Cheong-rae, leader of the Democratic Party of Korea, apologized again on the 4th regarding his "Try calling me oppa" remark made at Busan's Gupo Market on the 3rd. (정청래 더불어민주당 대표가 지난 3일 부산 구포시장 ‘오빠 해봐요’ 발언과 관련해 다시 사과했다.)

During a Supreme Council meeting held at the Busan Port International Exhibition and Convention Center on the 4th, Leader Chung said, "Regarding the situation during the visit to Gupo Market, I am sorry to the child and their parents, as the child found themselves at the center of controversy and was hurt." The previous day, while campaigning with Ha (candidate for the Busan Buk-gu by-election) at Gupo Market, Chung asked a first-grade elementary school student, "What grade are you in? Try calling this Jeongwoo oppa, say oppa," sparking criticism from the opposition. (정 대표는 4일 부산항 국제전시컨벤션센터열린 현장 최고위원회에서 “구포시장 방문 과정의 상황과 관련해 아이가 논란의 중심에 서게 되어 상처받으셨을 아이와 아이의 부모님께 송구하다”고 말했다. 정 대표는 전날 구포시장에서 부산북갑 국회의원 보궐선거에 나선 하 후보 지원 유세를 하다가 초등학교 1학년 어린이에게 “몇 학년이에요? 여기 정우 오빠, 오빠 해봐요”라고 말해 야권에서 비판을 쏟아냈다.)

Even within the Democratic Party, there were indications that the remarks were inappropriate. Former leader Song Young-gil appeared on YTN Radio's "Jang Seong-cheol's News Myeongdang" on the 4th and, when asked, "Do you think Chung Cheong-rae's actions are helpful for the elections in the Yeongnam region?" replied, "I wish it were left to Jeon Jae-soo (Busan mayoral candidate). Instead of going there and making mistakes, it seems better for our central party to just offer support from above." He added, "Since YouTube and others follow you 24/7, you can make mistakes if only parts are clipped out, so we have to be very cautious. The conservative camp is saying they'll just skip voting after seeing Jang Dong-hyeok's behavior, but if we make mistakes, it could [backfire and] unite them." (민주당에서도 부적절한 발언이었다는 지적이 나온다. 송영길 전 대표는 이날 와이티엔(YTN) 라디오 ‘장성철의 뉴스명당’에 출연해 “정청래 대표의 행보가 영남권 선거에 도움이 된다고 생각하느냐”는 질문에 “전재수 (부산시장) 후보에게 맡겨 놨으면 좋겠다”며 “우리 중앙에서는 거기 가서 막 또 실수하기보다는 위에서 그냥 지원해 주겠다고 하는 것이 좋을 거로 보여진다”고 말했다. 그는 “아무래도 유튜브 등이 24시간 계속 따라붙으면 일부만 딱 뽑아내면 실수를 할 수가 있어서 참 조심스럽다”며 “보수 세력들이 장동혁 대표의 행태를 보고 그냥 투표 안 해버린다 이러고 있는데, 우리가 실수를 하면 그걸 계기로 확 뭉칠 수가 있다”고 덧붙였다.)

Lawmaker Han Byeong-do said on the YouTube channel "Jang Yun-seon's Reporting Convenience Store" on the same day, "Although an apology was made immediately, it's necessary to be cautious with all remarks." (한병도 의원은 이날 유튜브 채널 ‘장윤선의 취재편의점’에서 “바로 사과를 했지만, 모든 발언에 신중할 필요가 있다”고 말했다.)

Late on the previous day, Candidate Ha stated, "During the process of meeting the child and local residents, the child ended up at the center of controversy. I apologize to the child and the parents who may have been hurt. I will meet residents with even greater caution and a lower, more humble attitude." (하 후보는 전날 밤늦게 “아이와 지역주민들을 만나는 과정에서 아이가 논란의 중심에 서게 돼 상처받으셨을 아이와 부모님께 사과의 말씀을 드린다. 더욱 조심해서 낮고 겸손한 자세로 주민분들을 만나겠다”고 밝혔다.)

Reporter Lee Ji-eun jieuny@hani.co.kr (이지은 기자 jieuny@hani.co.kr)

item.description:

item.title: Next After Choo Kyung-ho: Jung Jin-seok… MBC’s Second Direct Strike: “Can This Be Called a Break from Yoon Again?” (추경호 다음 정진석…MBC 두번째 직격 “윤어게인과 절연 맞나”)
item.description:
A Munhwa Broadcasting Corporation (MBC) anchor who pointed out that People Power Party Daegu mayoral candidate Rep. Choo Kyung-ho is a “defendant indicted on charges of engaging in critical duties during an insurrection” has now brought up former Presidential Chief of Staff Jung Jin-seok, who is rumored to be nominated, saying in a closing remark, “I want to ask again: Can this be called a break from ‘Yoon Again’?” This came amid the People Power Party’s offensive, vowing to “hold them strictly accountable through all possible means.” <<> Anchor Kim Kyung-ho ended the March 2 edition of “News Desk” by saying, “Last weekend, when I asked what it means to put forward a defendant indicted for engaging in critical duties during an insurrection as a metropolitan mayoral candidate, what came back was not an answer but a threat of a reporting boycott. Since then, aides to the defendant accused of being the ringleader of the insurrection, or those who have defended his actions, have been confirmed as candidates or are on the verge of receiving nominations. I want to ask again: Can this be called a break from ‘Yoon Again’?” <<> As Anchor Kim Kyung-ho spoke, images of former Chief of Staff Jung, former Broadcasting and Communications Commission Chair Lee Jin-sook, and former People Power Party lawmaker Lee Yong appeared in the background. These individuals are all considered “pro-Yoon” figures with ties to former President Yoon Suk-yeol. On March 1, the People Power Party gave a single nomination to former Chair Lee in Daegu Dalseong and to former lawmaker Lee in Gyeonggi Hanam-gap. Former lawmaker Lee, who served as Yoon’s executive secretary when Yoon was a presidential candidate and president-elect, has been called “Yoon Suk-yeol’s bodyguard.” Former Chief of Staff Jung, who was Yoon’s last chief of staff, announced his candidacy for the Gongju, Buyeo, and Cheongyang by-election on February 28. <<> The People Power Party’s offensive against MBC began on February 26, when it took issue with the closing remarks of “News Desk.” That day, Anchor Kim Cho-rong ended the broadcast by saying, “During the December 3 martial law, when the entire nation anxiously awaited the National Assembly’s vote to lift martial law, the behavior of then-People Power Party floor leader Choo Kyung-ho was as shocking as the martial law itself.” Anchor Kim Kyung-ho then said in a closing remark, “Many people still vividly remember that tense night—when the People Power Party caused chaos by changing the venue for the party meeting three times, resulting in many of its lawmakers not participating in the vote to lift martial law. I want to ask what it means to put forward a defendant indicted on charges of engaging in critical duties during an insurrection as a metropolitan mayoral candidate.” <<> Afterward, the People Power Party claimed that MBC had “conducted ‘election interference’ under the guise of a ‘closing remark’” (according to Senior Floor Spokesperson Choi Soo-jin). Following a demand for an official apology, the party said it would “hold them strictly accountable through all possible means, including legal and administrative action” (Senior Spokesperson Choi Bo-yoon) and mentioned “filing a complaint with the Korea Communications Standards Commission and taking strong legal action” (Senior Floor Spokesperson Park Choong-kwon). A party official from the floor leader’s office stated, “If there is no official apology, we will refuse to allow coverage.” <<> In contrast, the opposition party urged the ruling party to “immediately stop its ‘throwing stones and then putting up hands’ intimidation of the press.” Democratic Party Floor Spokesperson Kim Hyun-jung said on February 28, “The media merely asked a rightful question on behalf of the people: ‘What does it mean to put forward a defendant indicted for engaging in critical duties during an insurrection as a metropolitan mayoral candidate?’ Framing this as ‘election interference’ and threatening to refuse coverage is a ‘dictatorial mindset’ aimed at blocking inconvenient truths.” <<> The Citizens’ Coalition for Democratic Media (CCDM) also criticized the People Power Party’s offensive against MBC on February 29, calling it “blatant pressure on the media and inappropriate behavior.” The CCDM urged, “By ignoring the essence of the issue—the nomination of a person facing suspicions related to ‘insurrectionary acts’ recognized by the Constitutional Court and the courts—and shifting the blame to the media, the People Power Party is engaging in a classic case of ‘throwing stones and then putting up hands.’ The party must immediately stop its intimidation of the press.” <<> Reporter Jeon Gwang-jun light@hani.co.kr (국민의힘 대구시장 후보가 된 추경호 의원을 두고 ‘내란 중요임무 종사 혐의로 기소된 피고인’임을 짚은 문화방송(MBC) 앵커가 이번에는 ‘공천설’이 도는 정진석 전 대통령비서실장 등을 거론하며 “이걸 ‘윤 어게인’과의 절연이라고 할 수 있을지 다시 한번 묻고 싶다”고 클로징 멘트를 했다. 국민의힘이 “가능한 모든 수단으로 엄중히 책임을 묻겠다”며 공세에 나선 가운데 나온 말이다.)

item.title: Chung Jin-suk Says: ‘They Nominated an Insurrection Participant, Why Not Me?’ (정진석 “내란 종사자 공천했는데”…‘나는 왜 안 돼’ 항변)
item.description:
Chung Jin-suk, former lawmaker of the People Power Party and the final chief of staff to former President Yoon Suk-yeol, has directly rebutted criticism from within the party over his nomination application for a by-election for a National Assembly seat. (윤석열 전 대통령의 마지막 비서실장인 정진석 국민의힘 전 의원이 자신의 국회의원 보궐선거 공천 신청을 둘러싼 국민의힘 내 비판에 대해 정면 반박하고 나섰다.)

In a Facebook post today, Chung wrote: “In our party, they say ‘Chung Jin-suk is unacceptable’ and ‘Even staying quiet and doing nothing is more helpful to the party.’” He then asked: “When someone indicted for engaging in critical tasks related to an insurrection was selected as our party’s candidate for mayor of a metropolitan city, was there anyone who objected, saying they shouldn’t be nominated?” This was a reference to the nomination of former floor leader Koo Kyung-ho as the party’s candidate for mayor of Daegu. (정 전 의원은 이날 자신의 페이스북에 글을 올려 “우리 당 안에서 ‘정진석은 안 된다’, ‘너라도 가만히 있는 게 당을 돕는 일’이라고 한다”며 “내란 중요임무종사 혐의로 기소된 분이 우리 당 광역시장 후보에 선출됐는데, 이분 공천하면 안 된다고 이의제기한 사람이 누가 있었느냐”고 물었다. 국민의힘 대구시장 후보로 추경호 전 원내대표가 나서게 된 것을 언급한 것이다.)

Chung argued: “They say that since I was chief of staff, I should share joint responsibility. But the group that should bear joint responsibility for the collapse of the Yoon Suk-yeol administration is the ruling party at the time and its leadership. How does it look to the public when even those who smoothly secured their positions as provincial governors or special city mayors thanks to that person are viciously attacking me?” This appeared to target South Chungcheong Governor Kim Tae-heum and Seoul Mayor Oh Se-hoon. Governor Kim, who is seeking re-election, has opposed Chung’s nomination, even mentioning the possibility of running as an independent. Mayor Oh appeared on YTN radio’s ‘Jang Seong-cheol’s News Room’ today and said: “Since this election is held right after the martial law incident, it would be best for him to feel responsibility and exercise restraint—both for himself and for the party.” (그는 “비서실장을 했으니 공동책임을 져야 한다고 하는데, 윤석열 정부의 몰락에 공동책임을 져야 할 집단은 (당시) 집권여당과 그 당 지도부”라며 “그 분 덕에 도지사, 특별시장 수월하게 된 사람까지 나서서 (나를) 매몰차게 공격하는 게 국민들 눈에 어떻게 비치겠느냐”고 했다. 이는 김태흠 충남지사와 오세훈 서울시장을 겨냥한 것으로 보인다. 연임에 도전하는 김 지사는 ‘무소속 출마’까지 언급하며 그의 공천에 반대하고 있다. 오 시장은 이날 와이티엔(YTN) 라디오 ‘장성철의 뉴스명당’에 출연해 “이번 선거는 계엄 직후 치러지기 때문에 본인이 책임을 느낀다 하고 자제하는 것이 본인에게도, 당에도 도움이 된다고 본다”고 말했다.)

Chung further stated: “If there is any criticism I must accept simply for being in that role, I will endure it. But fairness with other nominees connected to former President Yoon must be considered. The argument that I should not even be allowed to participate in a primary—the minimal process through which local residents can choose their preferred candidate—is truly difficult to accept.” He added: “Representative Jang Dong-hyuk cut off candidates who ranked first or second in Daegu mayoral polls. The same could happen in the Gongju, Buyeo, and Cheongyang by-election where I am running. I will await the party’s decision.” (정 전 의원은 “제가 그 자리에 있었다는 것만으로 받아야 하는 어떤 비난이 있다면 당연히 감수하겠지만, 윤 (전) 대통령과 연관된 다른 공천자들과의 형평을 고려해야 한다”며 “지역 주민들이 원하는 후보를 선택하게 하는 최소한의 과정인 경선에조차 저를 참여시키지 말라는 주장은 참으로 납득하기 어렵다”고 말했다. 그러면서 “장동혁 대표는 대구시장 여론조사에서 1위, 2위를 차지하는 후보를 컷오프 시켰는데, (자신이 출마하는) 공주·부여·청양 재보궐 선거에서도 똑같은 일이 벌어질 수 있다”며 “당의 판단을 기다리겠다”고 덧붙였다.)

Reporter Lee Ji-eun jieuny@hani.co.kr (이지은 기자 jieuny@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Kang Hoon-sik: "Korea Expressway Corporation's 'Doseonghoe' Profit Distribution Excessive... Need Measures to Prevent Former Officials' Preferential Treatment" (강훈식 “도로공사 ‘도성회’ 수익배분 과도…전관예우 방지책을”)
item.description:
Presidential Chief of Staff Kang Hoon-sik stated on the 4th, "The public has suffered for decades due to illegal and unjust preferential treatment for former public institution retirees," and instructed the government to prepare measures to prevent recurrence. (강훈식 대통령비서실장이 4일 “공공기관 퇴직자에 대한 불법적이고 부당한 전관예우 탓에 국민들이 수십년 동안 피해를 보고 있다”며 정부에 재발 방지 대책을 마련하라고 지시했다.)

Chief Kang presided over a meeting of senior presidential secretaries and aides at the Cheong Wa Dae on the same day, citing "the case of 'Doseonghoe,' a retirees' group of the Korea Expressway Corporation, which operates highway rest areas for purposes unrelated to its founding objectives and distributes excessive profits," and criticized it as "an act betraying the responsibilities of a public institution," according to Deputy Presidential Spokesperson Ahn Gwi-ryeong. Previously, on the 10th of last month, The Hankyoreh 21 published a series of articles including "60 former officials of the Korea Expressway Corporation have taken control of 4 out of 10 rest areas nationwide." (강 실장은 이날 청와대 수석·보좌관 회의를 주재하며 “한국도로공사 퇴직자 단체인 ‘도성회’가 설립 목적과 무관하게 고속도로 휴게소를 운영하며 과도한 수익을 배분한 사례”를 언급하면서 “공공기관의 책무를 저버린 행위”라고 질타했다고 안귀령 청와대 부대변인이 전했다. 앞서, 한겨레21은 지난 달 10일 ‘전국 휴게소 10곳 중 4곳 도로공사 전관 60명이 장악했다’ 등의 기사를 연속 보도했다.)

Chief Kang urged the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport to "promptly devise measures to prevent preferential treatment for former officials so that highway rest areas are operated based on principles and common sense," and instructed the Ministry of Economy and Finance to inspect all former public institutions for similar cases. He further emphasized, "Efforts are needed to restore public trust, including the recovery of unjust profits and requesting investigations into illegal matters." (강 실장은 국토교통부에 “고속도로 휴게소가 원칙과 상식에 기반해 운영되도록 전관예우 방지 대책을 조속히 마련할 것”을 주문하고, 재정경제부에 전 공공기관을 대상으로 유사한 사례를 점검하라고 지시했다. 이어 “부당이익 환수 및 위법 사항에 대한 수사 의뢰 등 국민의 신뢰를 회복하기 위한 노력이 필요하다”고 당부했다.)

Additionally, Chief Kang noted, "According to a survey by the Korea Problem Gambling Prevention and Treatment Center, about 157,000 teenagers, or 4% of all adolescents last year, experienced illegal online gambling," and directed the National Police Agency to expand the 'Youth Gambling Voluntary Reporting System,' currently operated by some provincial police agencies, nationwide. (강 실장은 또, “한국도박문제예방치유원 조사 결과 지난해 전체 청소년의 4%인 약 15만7천명이 불법 온라인 도박을 경험한 것으로 나타났다”며 일부 시도경찰청이 운영 중인 ‘청소년 도박 자진신고 제도’를 전국으로 확대하라고 경찰청에 지시했다.)

Reporter Ko Kyung-ju goh@hani.co.kr (고경주 기자 goh@hani.co.kr)

item.title: PP’s Ansan-gap candidate with 4 criminal records: "Yoon declared martial law to protect the country" (전과 4범 국힘 안산갑 후보 “윤석열, 나라 지키려 계엄”)
item.description:
Amid growing controversy over 'Yoon Again' surrounding the People Power Party (PPP) nominations, it has been found that Kim Seok-hoon, the PPP candidate single-nominated for the by-election in Ansan-gap, Gyeonggi Province, defended the December 3 martial law, calling it "martial law to protect the country." (국민의힘 공천을 둘러싸고 ‘윤 어게인’ 논란이 커지는 가운데, 국회의원 재선거를 치르는 경기 안산갑에 단수 공천된 김석훈 국민의힘 후보가 12·3 비상계엄을 두고 “나라를 지키기 위한 계엄”이라고 옹호한 것으로 파악됐다.)

According to a video uploaded by far-right YouTuber Ko Sung-kook on his channel on the 4th, Ko conducted a conversation with candidate Kim on the 2nd in front of the Seoul Detention Center in Uiwang, Gyeonggi Province, where former President Yoon Suk Yeol is detained. (극우 유튜버 고성국씨가 4일 자신의 유튜브 채널에 올린 영상을 보면, 고씨는 지난 2일 윤석열 전 대통령이 수감돼 있는 경기 의왕시 서울구치소 앞에서 김 후보와 대담을 진행했다.)

First, Ko explained how the conversation came about, saying, "While busy campaigning, candidate Kim heard my broadcast saying I was heading to the Seoul Detention Center to cover the 56th 'Yoon Again' rally, and he rushed to the scene to join us and gather our hearts even for a moment in front of the Seoul Detention Center." (먼저 고씨는 “한참 선거운동을 하다가 ‘윤 어게인’ 56차 집회를 취재하러 서울구치소로 간다는 제 방송을 듣고, 함께 서울구치소 앞에서 잠깐이라도 마음을 모으겠다고 안산갑 국민의힘 김석훈 후보가 현장으로 달려왔다”며 대담이 성사된 배경을 설명했다.)

During the conversation, Ko said, "Wasn't the catalyst that made the 2030 generation awaken on their own, declare 'I am enlightened,' and begin to act as freedom-right citizens President Yoon Suk Yeol's December 3 martial law, who is now imprisoned here at the Seoul Detention Center?" Kim replied, "Yes, that's right." (대담에서 고씨가 “2030세대가 스스로 각성하고 ‘내가 계몽됐다’고 선언하면서 자유우파 국민으로서 행동하기 시작한 계기, 그건 지금 여기 서울구치소에 갇혀 계시는 윤석열 대통령의 12·3 계엄 아니었나”라고 하자 김 후보는 “네, 맞습니다”라고 답했다.)

Then, pointing to the Seoul Detention Center, Ko asked Kim, "President Yoon Suk Yeol is locked inside there even now. What comes to mind?" (이어 고씨는 서울구치소를 가리키며 “윤석열 대통령, 저 안에 갇혀 계신다 지금도. 어떤 생각이 드나”라고 김 후보에게 물었다.)

In response, candidate Kim said, "(Former President Yoon) truly wanted to protect this country, to protect it from the opposition's majority seats, to escape that environment, and essentially imposed martial law for that." He added, "He is now suffering because of the number of seats or the thuggish actions of the left, and in the process of wrongful laws being created." (그러자 김 후보는 “(윤 전 대통령은) 정말 이 나라를 지키려고, (야당이) 과반(인) 의석에서 이 나라를 지키기 위해서, 그 환경을 벗어나기 위해 가지고 사실상 계엄을 했다”고 답했다. 그러면서 “의석수 내지는 좌파들의 깡패 같은 어떤 행동에 의해 가지고, 잘못된 법이 만들어지는 과정에서 지금 현재 이 고생을 하고 계신다”고 덧붙였다.)

Earlier, on the 22nd of last month, the PPP single-nominated candidate Kim, a former Ansan City Council chairman, for Gyeonggi Ansan-gap. At the time, PPP Nomination Management Committee Chairman Park Deok-heum stated the reason for the nomination, saying, "He is a verified worker who has long handled local issues" and "He has solid competitiveness to represent the diverse voices of Ansan citizens and smoothly resolve the many pending livelihood tasks." According to the National Election Commission website, candidate Kim has four criminal records: violations of the Urban Planning Act and Building Act, violations of the Public Official Election and Election Malpractice Prevention Act, violations of the Act on the Regulation of Amusement Businesses, and obstruction of business, each resulting in a fine of 1 million won. (앞서 국민의힘은 지난달 22일 안산시의회 의장 출신인 김 후보를 경기 안산갑에 단수 공천했다. 당시 박덕흠 국민의힘 공천관리위원장은 “오랜 기간 지역 현안을 챙겨온 검증된 일꾼”이라며 “안산 시민들의 다양한 목소리를 대변하고 산적한 민생 과제들을 막힘없이 해결해 낼 경쟁력을 확고히 갖췄다”며 공천 이유를 밝혔다. 중앙선거관리위원회 누리집을 보면, 김 후보는 전과 4범으로 도시계획법·건축법 위반, 공직선거 및 선거부정방지법 위반, 풍속영업의 규제에 관한 법률 위반, 업무방해 등으로 각각 벌금 100만원씩을 받은 바 있다.)

Recently, the PPP has intensified the 'Yoon Again' nomination controversy by single-nominating numerous pro-Yoon Suk Yeol figures for the June 3 by-elections for National Assembly seats, held alongside local elections. On the 1st, the PPP single-nominated Lee Jin-sook, former Chair of the Korea Communications Commission, and Kim Tae-gyu, former Vice Chair of the Korea Communications Commission, both from the Yoon Suk Yeol administration, for Daegu Dalseong and Ulsan Nam-gu-gap, respectively. Lee Yong, a former PPP lawmaker who served as chief of staff during Yoon's presidential campaign and after his election, was also single-nominated for Gyeonggi Hanam-gap. Former lawmaker Jeong Jin-seok, who was Yoon's last chief of staff, declared his candidacy for the by-election in Gongju, Buyeo, and Cheongyang in South Chungcheong Province on the 30th of last month. (최근 국민의힘이 친윤석열계 인사들을 6·3 지방선거와 함께 치러지는 국회의원 재보궐선거에 대거 단수 공천하면서 ‘윤 어게인’ 공천 논란이 격화하고 있다. 국민의힘은 지난 1일 윤석열 정부에서 공직을 맡은 이진숙 전 방송통신위원장과 김태규 전 방송통신위원회 부위원장을 각각 대구 달성과 울산남구갑에 단수 공천했다. 윤 전 대통령이 대선후보와 당선인일 때 수행실장을 지낸 이용 전 국민의힘 의원도 경기 하남갑에 단수 공천했다. 윤 전 대통령의 마지막 비서실장이었던 정진석 전 의원은 지난달 30일 충남 공주·부여·청양 보궐선거 출마를 선언한 상태다.)

Reporter Jeon Gwang-jun light@hani.co.kr (전광준 기자 light@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Trump Associate: President Lee's Nuclear Submarine and Nuclear Energy Agreement Rivals Nixon's Achievement (트럼프 측근 “이 대통령 ‘핵잠·원자력 합의’, 닉슨 버금가는 성과”)
item.description:
Fred Fleitz, Deputy Director of the America First Policy Institute (AFPI) and known as an associate of U.S. President Donald Trump, has assessed the agreement between President Lee Jae-myung and President Trump on nuclear-powered submarine (nuclear sub) and nuclear energy cooperation as an achievement comparable to "Nixon's visit to China," emphasizing that the Trump administration should move forward with it swiftly. (도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령의 측근으로 알려진 프레드 플라이츠 미국우선주의정책연구소(AFPI) 부소장이 이재명 대통령과 트럼프 대통령의 핵추진잠수함(핵잠)·원자력 협력 합의를 ‘닉슨 방중’에 버금가는 성과로 평가하면서, 트럼프 행정부가 이를 신속하게 진전시켜야 한다고 강조했다.)

In a contribution titled "The Urgent Need to Implement South Korea-U.S. Nuclear-Powered Submarine and Nuclear Fuel Cycle Agreements" posted on the Institute for National Security Strategy's website on the 4th, Deputy Director Fleitz stated, "The nuclear technology cooperation agreement between the leaders of South Korea and the U.S. is a groundbreaking milestone in South Korea-U.S. security cooperation." He suggested, "The Trump administration must work with Congress to rapidly provide South Korea with comprehensive nuclear propulsion technology, reactor design support, nuclear fuel cycle cooperation, and development paths for next-generation reactors, including Small Modular Reactors (SMRs)." Presidents Lee Jae-myung and Trump agreed in a joint fact sheet summarizing the outcomes of two summits last year to advance South Korea's construction of nuclear submarines and enrichment and reprocessing. However, variables such as U.S. dissatisfaction with delays in South Korean investment in the U.S., the U.S.-Israel-Iran war, and the Coupang lobbying issue have left South Korea-U.S. security negotiations at a standstill. (플라이츠 부소장은 4일 국가안보전략연구원 홈페이지에 실은 ‘한미간 핵추진잠수함 및 핵연료주기 이행이 시급하다’는 제목의 기고에서 “한미 양국 정상의 핵기술 협력 합의는 한미 안보협력의 획기적 이정표”라며 “트럼프 행정부는 의회와 협력해 한국에 핵추진 기술 전반과 원자로 설계 지원, 핵연료주기 협력, 그리고 소형 모듈 원자로(SMR)를 포함한 차세대 원자로 개발 경로를 신속하게 제공해야 한다”고 제안했다. 이재명 대통령과 트럼프 대통령은 지난해 2차례의 정상회담의 결과를 담은 조인트 팩트시트를 통해 한국의 핵잠 건조와 농축·재처리를 진전시키기로 합의했다. 하지만 미국이 한국의 대미투자 지연에 불만을 표하고, 미국·이스라엘-이란 전쟁, 쿠팡 로비 등의 변수가 더해지면서 한미 안보 협상은 아직 첫발도 떼지못하고 있다.)

Deputy Director Fleitz praised, "President Lee Jae-myung has built a practical, transactional, and productive relationship with the Trump administration," adding, "As a progressive-leaning leader, President Lee broke away from the traditional progressive stance and signed a major strategic agreement with the U.S. focused on nuclear submarine construction, uranium enrichment, and peaceful nuclear fuel reprocessing cooperation." He further noted, "With a nuclear-armed hostile force on the Korean Peninsula and the rapid modernization of the Chinese navy, this is a belated recognition that South Korea can no longer maintain deterrence with conventional diesel-electric submarines alone." (플라이츠 부소장은 “이재명 대통령은 트럼프 행정부와 실용적이고 거래적이며 생산적인 관계를 구축해 왔다”며 “진보 성향 지도자인 이 대통령이 기존 진보 진영의 입장에서 벗어나 핵잠 건조와 우라늄 농축 및 평화적 핵연료 재처리 협력을 골자로 하는 미국과의 주요 전략적 합의를 체결한 것”을 높이 평가했다. 그는 “한반도에 핵무장을 한 적대 세력이 존재하고 중국 해군이 급속히 현대화되고 있는 상황에서, 한국은 더이상 재래식 디젤-전기 잠수함만으로는 억지력을 유지할 수 없다는 현실에 대한 뒤늦은 인정”이라고 덧붙였다.)

Addressing concerns about nuclear proliferation, he emphasized, "South Korea is a model member of the Nuclear Non-Proliferation Treaty (NPT)" and countered, "Given that North Korea has blatantly violated its nuclear treaty obligations, possesses an estimated 50 nuclear warheads, and is reportedly building nuclear submarines, restricting South Korea's access to necessary nuclear technology is not a responsible non-proliferation policy but a strategic mistake." (그는 또, 핵확산 우려에 대해 “한국은 핵확산금지조약(NPT)의 모범 회원국”이라고 강조하고 “북한이 핵 관련 조약 의무를 노골적으로 위반하고 약 50기로 추정되는 핵무기를 보유하고 있으며, 현재 핵잠을 건조중인 것으로 알려진 상황에서 한국에 필요한 핵 기술 접근을 제한하는 것은 책임있는 비확산 정책이 아니라 전략적 실책”이라고 반박했다.)

Fleitz remarked, "In 1972, only Richard Nixon (a lifelong anti-communist) could go to China. Similarly, in 2025, it may be that only President Lee Jae-myung (a progressive) could, through negotiations with President Donald Trump, achieve the historic agreement for South Korea's first nuclear submarine construction and nuclear fuel cycle cooperation." (플라이츠 부소장은 “1972년 중국에 갈 수 있었던 인물은 (평생 반공주의자였던) 리처드 닉슨뿐이었다. 마찬가지로 2025년 도널드 트럼프 대통령과의 협상을 통해 한국 최초의 핵잠 건조와 핵연료주기 협력이라는 역사적 합의를 이끌어낼 수 있는 인물은, 어쩌면 (진보 성향의) 이재명 대통령이었을 뿐일 가능성이 크다”고 말했다.)

Deputy Director Fleitz, a former CIA officer, served as Chief of Staff of the White House National Security Council (NSC) during the first Trump administration. The America First Policy Institute is a pro-Trump think tank. While he once held a critical stance toward President Lee, he has recently shifted to a cooperative posture with the Lee Jae-myung government and has been appointed as a research advisory member of the Institute for National Security Strategy under the National Intelligence Service. (미 중앙정보국(CIA) 출신인 플라이츠 부소장은 트럼프 행정부 1기 당시 백악관 국가안보회의(NSC) 비서실장을 지냈다. 미국우선주의정책연구소는 친트럼프 성향 싱크탱크다. 그는 한때 이 대통령에 대해 비판적 입장을 보였지만, 최근 이재명 정부와도 협력하는 기조로 변신해 국가정보원 산하 국가안보전략연구원 연구자문위원에 위촉됐다.)

item.title: "Due to Terror Threat Intelligence…" Kim Sang-wook's Reason for Wearing a 'Stab-Proof Vest' (“테러 협박 첩보에…” 김상욱 ‘방검 셔츠’ 입은 사정)
item.description:
Former lawmaker Kim Sang-wook, running as the Democratic Party of Korea candidate for Ulsan mayor in the June 3 local elections, revealed that he is campaigning while wearing a "stab-proof vest" because he "has been receiving death threats." (6·3 지방선거에서 더불어민주당 울산시장 후보로 나선 김상욱 전 의원이 “테러 협박을 받고 있다”며 ‘방검 셔츠’를 입고 선거운동을 하고 있다고 밝혔다.)

In a video uploaded by a YouTuber on the 3rd, candidate Kim showed a gray shirt worn under a blue jacket, saying, "I can't post my (campaign) schedule in advance. Why not? Because I'm being threatened. They say they'll commit an act of terror." Kim added, "This is a stab-proof vest. It's a vest that won't let a knife through even if you're stabbed. But I will not back down." (지난 3일 한 유튜버가 올린 영상을 보면, 김 후보는 “제가 (선거 운동) 일정을 (사전에) 못 올린다. 왜 못 올리냐고요? 협박받고 있다. 테러하겠다고 한다”며 파란색 점퍼 안에 입은 회색 셔츠를 보여줬다. 김 후보는 “이거 방검 셔츠다. 칼에 찔려도 안 들어가는 방검 셔츠”라며 “하지만 굴하지 않겠다”고 말했다.)

Candidate Kim shared the full details during a live broadcast on his YouTube channel that day. He stated, "To be honest, I am facing various threats. I'm receiving multiple intelligence reports, so I'm being cautious." He continued, "If I hesitate to engage with the people out of fear that I might get hurt, that would be wrong. I will engage more safely and carefully, and go deeper among the citizens." (김 후보는 이날 자신의 유튜브 채널에서 진행한 라이브 방송에서 자세한 사정을 전했다. 김 후보는 “솔직히 말씀드리면 여러 가지 위협을 받고 있다”며 “여러 가지 첩보들이 들어오고 있어서 조심하고 있다”고 말했다. 김 후보는 또 “제가 다칠까 봐 두려워서 시민 속으로 들어가는 것을 망설인다면 그건 잘못된 것”이라며 “더 안전하게, 조심하면서 더 시민 속으로 들어가겠다”고 했다.)

Kim then mentioned the incident on January 2, 2024, when then-Democratic Party leader Lee Jae-myung was attacked with a weapon in Gadeokdo, Busan. He said, "The other side says I'm overreacting and talks nonsense." He added, "What did they do then? Even if the blade had deviated just a little, it would have threatened his life. That weapon was a complete deadly weapon. Yet they used that to say it was some kind of show, utter nonsense." (김 후보는 이어 “상대방은 ‘오버한다’면서 막 이상한 소리를 한다”며 앞서 이재명 대통령이 더불어민주당 대표였던 2024년 1월2일 부산 가덕도에서 흉기 테러를 당했던 사건을 언급했다. 김 후보는 “(당시) 저쪽에선 어떻게 했냐? 정말 조금만 칼날이 비껴갔어도 목숨을 위협하는 그리고 그 칼이란 것도 완전히 흉기였다. 무기였다. 그런데 그걸 가지고 말도 안 되는, 막 무슨 쇼 한다고 그랬다”고 했다.)

Kim also referenced President Yoon's use of a bulletproof glass barrier during his campaign rally in May of last year, saying, "They mocked that too from the People Power Party side. It makes my blood boil. Why resort to violence in politics?" (또 이 대통령이 대통령 후보 시절인 지난해 5월 유세할 때 방탄 유리막을 사용했던 것도 언급하면서 “그거 가지고 국민의힘 쪽에서 또 조롱했다”며 “생각하면 피가 거꾸로 솟는다. 왜 정치에서 폭력을 쓰려고 하냐”고 말했다.)

Kim added, "Anyway, I don't want to cause inconvenience to the citizens by making it too obvious. I hope citizens will welcome me naturally. I ask for your understanding that I cannot announce my schedule in advance. If I reveal my schedule publicly, it actually becomes more dangerous." (김 후보는 “어쨌든 너무 티 내는 건 시민들께 또 불편함을 드릴까 싶다. 저는 시민들이 저를 편하게 받아들여 줬으면 좋겠다”며 “일정을 미리 공지를 못 하는 점은 양해를 구하겠다. 제가 일정을 미리 다 공지해버리면 사실 좀 더 위험해진다”고 덧붙였다.)

Kim, who was elected as a member of the National Assembly for Ulsan Nam-gu District A under the People Power Party in the May 2024 general election, later criticized the December 3 insurrection and called for the impeachment of former President Yoon Suk-yeol. He left the People Power Party in May last year and joined the Democratic Party. Kim resigned from his parliamentary seat on the 29th of last month to run for Ulsan mayor. (2024년 5월 총선에서 국민의힘 소속으로 울산 남구갑 국회의원이 된 김 후보는 이후 12·3 내란을 비판하고 윤석열 전 대통령의 탄핵을 촉구하다 지난해 5월 국민의힘에서 탈당한 뒤 민주당에 입당했다. 김 후보는 울산시장 선거에 출마하기 위해 지난달 29일 의원직을 사퇴했다.)

By Song Kyung-hwa, reporter freehwa@hani.co.kr (송경화 기자 freehwa@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Who Will Be the New National Assembly Speaker? Jo Jeong-sik, Kim Tae-nyeon, Park Ji-won in 'Three-Way Contest Among Democratic Heavyweights' (새 국회의장 누가 될까…조정식·김태년·박지원 ‘민주 중진 3파전’)
item.description:
The election for the National Assembly Speaker, who will represent the latter half of the 22nd Assembly for two years, is shaping up as a three-way race among Democratic Party of Korea lawmakers Jo Jeong-sik (six-term), Kim Tae-nyeon (five-term), and Park Ji-won (five-term). (22대 후반기 국회를 2년 동안 대표할 국회의장 선거가 더불어민주당 조정식(6선)·김태년(5선)·박지원(5선) 의원의 3파전으로 치러진다.)

On the 4th, the candidate registration day for the Democratic Party's National Assembly Speaker race, lawmakers Jo Jeong-sik, Kim Tae-nyeon, and Park Ji-won held consecutive press conferences at the Assembly to announce their intention to run. The National Assembly Speaker is elected through a final vote in the plenary session after the ruling party determines its candidate via a primary race. In effect, the winner of the Democratic Party primary is chosen as the Speaker. (민주당 국회의장 후보 등록일인 4일 조정식·김태년·박지원 의원은 국회에서 연이어 기자회견을 열고 의장 출마 뜻을 밝혔다. 국회의장은 원내 1당이 경선을 거쳐 후보를 확정한 뒤 국회 본회의 표결로 선출된다. 사실상 민주당 경선 승자가 국회의장으로 선출되는 구조다.)

All three lawmakers emphasized their commitment to creating an Assembly that takes charge of the livelihoods economy, working in tandem with the Lee Jae-myung administration. In particular, they pledged to "pursue constitutional reform, including a restructuring of the power structure." Rep. Jo stated, "My goal is singular: winning the 23rd general election and, furthermore, laying the groundwork for a return to power. What matters most is the harmony and stability with the government." He promised to "form a special committee on constitutional reform immediately upon taking office," advocating for a system allowing a president to serve four-year terms with the possibility of reelection. Rep. Kim pledged to establish a People's Livelihood Economic Strategy Council under the Speaker, create a diplomatic bureau within the Assembly, and transfer the Board of Audit and Inspection to the Assembly, while Rep. Park vowed to push forward reform tasks such as prosecutorial and judicial reform. (세 의원 모두 이재명 정부와 호흡을 맞춰 민생 경제를 책임지는 국회를 만들겠다고 강조했다. 특히 ‘권력구조 개편을 포함한 개헌을 하겠다’고 약속했다. 조 의원은 “제 목표는 단 하나다. 23대 총선 승리, 더 나아가 정권 재창출의 교두보를 놓는 것”이라며 “무엇보다 중요한 건 바로 정부와의 호흡과 안정감”이라고 했다. 그는 “취임 즉시 개헌특위를 구성하겠다”며 개헌을 통한 대통령 4년 연임제를 공약했다. 김 의원은 의장 직속 민생경제전략회의체 및 국회 외교처 신설, 감사원의 국회 이관 등을 공약했고, 박 의원은 검찰·사법개혁 등 개혁과제에 힘을 싣겠다고 밝혔다.)

In this election, Rep. Jo, who has been evaluated as the 'Lee pick' (the candidate chosen by President Lee Jae-myung) since being appointed as a special political advisor to President Lee last year, is leading the pack, with Rep. Kim, a 'policy expert' with faint factional colors, trailing behind. Rep. Park, who enjoys high public recognition, is assessed as receiving support from hardline party members for his leadership in handling reform legislation. (이번 선거는 지난해 이재명 대통령 정무특보로 위촉되면서 후보군 중 ‘명픽’(이재명 대통령이 선택한 후보)이라는 평가를 받아 온 조 의원이 앞서는 가운데, 계파색이 옅은 ‘정책통’ 김 후보가 그 뒤를 쫓는 구도다. 높은 대중 인지도를 가진 박 의원은 개혁 입법 처리에 앞장서며 강성 당원들의 지지를 받고 있다는 평가를 받는다.)

For the first time in this National Assembly Speaker election, the votes of fee-paying party members will be reflected. The final candidate will be determined by combining 80% of the votes from incumbent lawmakers and 20% from fee-paying party members, selecting the candidate with an absolute majority. The online vote for fee-paying party members will take place on the 11th and 12th, followed by an in-person vote by lawmakers on the 13th to decide the final nominee. (이번 국회의장 선거에는 처음으로 권리당원 투표가 반영된다. 재적 의원 투표 80%에 권리당원 투표 20%가 합산돼 과반 득표자를 뽑는다. 오는 11∼12일 권리당원 온라인 투표와 13일 의원 현장 투표로 최종 후보가 결정된다.)

Reporter Kim Chae-woon cwk@hani.co.kr (김채운 기자 cwk@hani.co.kr)

item.title: "Is President Lee trying to become the supreme dignity?"...Jang Dong-hyuk criticizes the manipulated indictment special counsel law with red-baiting rhetoric. (“이 대통령, 최고존엄 되려하나”…장동혁, 색깔론으로 조작기소 특검법 비판)
item.description:
Jang Dong-hyuk, the leader of the People Power Party, has repeatedly compared President Lee Jae-myung to North Korean leader Kim Jong-un, the General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and Chairman of the State Affairs Commission, employing red-baiting tactics. (장동혁 국민의힘 대표가 이재명 대통령을 연일 김정은 북한 조선노동당 총비서 겸 국무위원장에 빗대며 색깔론을 꺼내 들었다.)

At the party's Supreme Council meeting held at the National Assembly on the 4th, Representative Jang said, "There's only one person on the Korean Peninsula who won't go to prison no matter what crime they commit. That's North Korea's supreme dignity, Kim Jong-un." He added, "It seems there will be one more now. Does President Lee Jae-myung want to become 'Supreme Dignity No. 2'?" (장 대표는 4일 국회에서 열린 당 최고위원회의에서 “무슨 죄를 지어도 감옥에 안 가는 사람이 한반도에 딱 한명 있다. 북한 최고존엄 김정은”이라며 “이제 한명 더 늘어날 것 같다. 이재명 대통령은 ‘최고존엄 넘버2’가 되고 싶은 건가”라고 말했다.)

Representative Jang also criticized the 'Manipulated Indictment Special Counsel Law,' proposed by the Democratic Party, calling it "a law that exists for only one person," and stated, "This isn't a law; it's violence and a crime. They might as well enact the 'Lee Jae-myung Supreme Dignity Law.'" The previous day, at the opening ceremony of the election office for People Power Party Daegu mayoral candidate Choo Kyung-ho, Jang had also criticized, "President Lee has long been a spokesperson for Kim Jong-un." (장 대표는 더불어민주당 주도로 발의된 ‘조작기소 특검법’이 “한 사람만을 위해 존재하는 법”이라며 “이건 법이 아니라 폭력이자 범죄다. 차라리 ‘이재명 최고존엄법’을 만들라”고도 했다. 장 대표는 전날 추경호 국민의힘 대구시장 후보 선거사무소 개소식에서도 “이 대통령은 김정은 대변인이 된 지 오래”라고 비판한 바 있다.)

The Democratic Party countered, saying, "Those who trampled on democracy are now resorting to red-baiting again without any apology or reflection." (민주당은 “민주주의를 짓밟은 이들이 사과와 반성 없이 다시 꺼낸 건 색깔론”이라고 비판했다.)

At a field Supreme Council meeting held at the Busan Port International Exhibition and Convention Center in Dong-gu, Busan, on the same day, Representative Jeong Cheong-rae stated, "Those who try to turn back the wheels of history with outdated red-baiting must face severe judgment." Kim Hyun-jung, the deputy floor spokesperson, also said in a written briefing, "After going in circles and nominating 'Yoon Again,' what they've pulled out is old, worn-out red-baiting like 'spokesperson for Kim Jong-un' and 'amendment to the socialist constitution.'" (정청래 대표는 이날 부산 동구 부산항국제전시컨벤션센터에서 열린 현장 최고위원회의에서 “낡은 색깔론으로 역사의 수레바퀴를 되돌리려는 저들에게 준엄한 심판이 있어야 한다”며 이렇게 말했다. 김현정 원내대변인도 서면 브리핑에서 “돌고 돌아 ‘윤 어게인’ 공천을 하더니 꺼내 든 것은 ‘김정은의 대변인’ ‘사회주의 헌법 개정’과 같은 낡디낡은 색깔론”이라고 했다.)

item.title: Choo Kyung-ho: “Chance of Guilty Verdict for Insurrection Duties? Lower than Being Struck by Lightning in Clear Sky” (추경호 “내란 중요임무 유죄? 날벼락 맞을 확률보다 낮아”)
item.description:
“Every day, I sense the scattered conservative support base rapidly consolidating. Only I, who served as Deputy Prime Minister for the Economy, can revive Daegu’s economy.” (“매일매일 흩어진 보수 지지층이 빠르게 결집하는 것을 느낀다. 경제부총리까지 한 저만이 대구 경제를 다시 살릴 수 있다.”)

Choo Kyung-ho, the People Power Party candidate for Daegu mayor, emphasized “the economy” multiple times during an interview with The Hankyoreh at his campaign office in Suseong-gu, Daegu on the 4th, saying he feels the conservatives gathering on the ground. Regarding the special counsel bill for manipulated indictments proposed by the Democratic Party, Choo stated, “Their arrogance is sky-high. The people will surely deliver a stern judgment.” He also sharply criticized his opponent, Democratic Party candidate Kim Boo-kyum, saying, “When he was prime minister, he did nothing for Daegu.” <<> Concerning his indictment without detention on charges of engaging in important duties related to insurrection, for allegedly moving the party meeting venue multiple times as the People Power Party floor leader during the December 3 martial law crisis, he strongly denied it, saying, “The probability of being found guilty is lower than the chance of being struck by lightning in a clear sky.” After visiting former President Park Geun-hye on the same day alongside Gyeongbuk Governor candidate Lee Cheol-woo of the same party, Choo reported, “Former President Park told us that Daegu must play its role as the center of conservatism.” <<> —Why are you the right person for the job? <<> “Who will revive the stagnant economy is the biggest topic in Daegu society. Having worked in economic ministries my entire life and served as Deputy Prime Minister for the Economy, I will use that experience to fulfill my role in revitalizing Daegu’s economy.” <<> —What are your key pledges? <<> “I will carry out a major reform of Daegu’s economy. I will create a city where money and people gather, and generate jobs. I will transform Daegu’s main industries into AI and future mobility advanced industries. I will make Daegu a national model startup city and establish a semiconductor cluster. There is a strong demand for competitive large corporations in the region. I will immediately launch an investment attraction team.” <<> —Democratic Party candidate Kim Boo-kyum is promoting himself as an ‘efficacious ruling party candidate.’ <<> “I question his sincerity. Citizens evaluate that when he served as prime minister and minister under the Moon Jae-in government in 2018, he did nothing for Daegu. If he couldn’t do it then, how can someone who isn’t even a key Lee Jae-myung ally accomplish it under a Lee Jae-myung administration? I see it as lip service for campaign strategy. The Daegu-Gyeongbuk administrative integration bill could have passed if the Democratic Party had decided to support it—what did he do then?” <<> —You’re trailing behind candidate Kim Boo-kyum in polls. <<> “Until the candidate was confirmed, many internal conflicts within the party were exposed. The nomination process was also not smooth, leading to public discontent. However, since the candidate was confirmed, the scattered conservative support base has been rapidly consolidating.” <<> In a survey conducted by Ace Research on behalf of Daegu MBC on the 2nd and 3rd, Democratic Party candidate Kim Boo-kyum received 45.9% support, while People Power Party candidate Choo Kyung-ho got 42.4%, narrowing the gap between the two candidates within the margin of error. (For details, refer to the National Election Survey Deliberation Commission website.) <<> —What is your strategy to overturn the election? <<> “Citizens have started to gather based on my economic capabilities, and the perception that Daegu, the heart of conservatism, must play its role is spreading.” <<> —The Democratic Party proposed a special counsel bill for manipulated indictments. <<> “I question whether this is a feasible idea under a liberal democracy. Trying to create a law to cancel an indictment is an outrage against the constitutional order. Their arrogance is sky-high. The people will surely deliver a stern judgment.” <<> —The Democratic Party is attacking you for being indicted without detention on charges of engaging in important duties related to insurrection. <<> “It’s just political manipulation of the insurrection narrative. The probability of being found guilty is lower than the chance of being struck by lightning in a clear sky. I also want to ask if the Democratic Party is qualified to attack me over judicial risks. Gyeongnam Governor candidate Kim Kyoung-soo lost his previous gubernatorial post due to the ‘Druking’ comment manipulation case, and Busan Mayor candidate Jeon Jae-soo has faced bribery allegations.” <<> —You visited former President Park Geun-hye today (4th). Do you plan to ask for her support in campaigning? <<> “This wasn’t a meeting to request campaign support. I believe former President Park will decide based on the situation.” <<> Daegu / Reporter Kim Hae-jeong sea@hani.co.kr (추경호 국민의힘 대구시장 후보는 4일 대구 수성구 선거사무실에서 한겨레와 한 인터뷰에서 ‘경제’를 여러 차례 강조하면서 현장에서 보수층이 모이는 것을 체감한다고 했다. 추 후보는 더불어민주당이 발의한 조작기소 특검법에 대해 “오만함이 하늘을 찌른다. 반드시 국민이 엄중한 심판을 할 것”이라고 했다. 상대인 김부겸 민주당 후보에 대해서는 “총리일 때 대구에 해놓은 게 없다”고 일갈했다.)

item.title: 'Opposition Alliance' Provoked by Fabricated Indictment Special Counsel Law..."Democratic Candidates, State Your Position" (‘야권 연대’ 자극한 조작기소 특검법…“민주 후보자들, 입장 밝혀라”)
item.description:
Conservative opposition parties have sharpened their stance against the ruling party by holding a joint meeting triggered by the Democratic Party's proposal of the 'Special Counsel Act for Investigating the Truth Behind the Yoon Seok-yeol Regime's Fabricated Indictments' (Fabricated Indictment Special Counsel Act). Through an all-out offensive on the Fabricated Indictment Special Counsel Act, they are seeking to shift the electoral landscape ahead of the June 3 local elections, where they have been at a disadvantage. (보수 야당들이 더불어민주당의 ‘윤석열 정권 조작기소 진상규명 특검법안’(조작기소 특검법) 발의를 계기로 연석회의를 열며 정부 여당에 각을 세웠다. 이들은 조작기소 특검법 총공세를 통해 열세였던 6·3 지방선거 판세 변동을 꾀하고 있다.)

People Power Party Seoul mayoral candidate Oh Se-hoon and Incheon mayoral candidate Yoo Jeong-bok, along with Reform Party Gyeonggi governor candidate Cho Eung-cheon and Seoul mayoral candidate Kim Jeong-cheol, held an 'Emergency Joint Meeting of Metropolitan Area Regional Leaders Candidates to Prevent Judicial Insurrection' at the National Assembly on the 4th. They stated, "President Lee Jae-myung must declare, 'There will absolutely be no withdrawal of the indictment regarding my charges during my term, and I will stand trial according to the law and principles.'" They added, "For candidates in the local elections to remain silent on this matter is an act of historical dereliction of duty," and demanded, "Democratic Party Seoul mayoral candidate Jeong Won-oh, Incheon mayoral candidate Park Chan-dae, and Gyeonggi governor candidate Choo Mi-ae should immediately announce a clear position on the special counsel act." (국민의힘 오세훈 서울시장 후보, 유정복 인천시장 후보와 개혁신당 조응천 경기지사 후보, 김정철 서울시장 후보는 4일 국회에서 ‘사법내란 저지를 위한 수도권 광역단체장 후보자 긴급 연석회의’를 열고 “이재명 대통령은 ‘임기 중 나의 혐의에 대한 공소 취소는 절대 없으며 법과 원칙에 따라 재판을 받겠다’고 선언하라”고 말했다. 이들은 “지방선거 후보자들이 이 사태에 입을 닫는 건 역사적 직무유기”며 “민주당 정원오 서울시장 후보, 박찬대 인천시장 후보, 추미애 경기지사 후보는 특검법에 대한 명확한 입장을 즉각 발표하라”고 요구했다.)

This joint meeting came about after candidate Cho Eung-cheon proposed it the previous day, with People Power Party candidates agreeing to participate. (이날 연석회의는 전날 조응천 후보가 제안하고 국민의힘 후보들이 응하면서 이뤄졌다.)

Candidate Cho stated, "The arrogant and reckless Lee Jae-myung regime has united the metropolitan area candidates." Regarding President Lee's message that "the ruling Democratic Party should decide on specific timing and procedures through gathering public opinion and deliberation," Oh Se-hoon told reporters after the meeting, "This is not a matter to be resolved by asking the public or the party for opinions. The president's duty is to urge the Democratic Party to withdraw the bill." (조 후보는 “오만하고 무도한 이재명 정권이 수도권 후보들을 하나로 뭉치게 했다”고 말했다. 오세훈 후보는 회동 뒤 기자들과 만나 ‘구체적인 시기와 절차에 대해서는 여당인 민주당이 국민적 의견 수렴과 숙의 과정을 거쳐 판단해달라’는 이 대통령 메시지에 대해 “국민이나 당의 의견을 물어서 처리할 사안은 아니다”라며 “법안을 철회하도록 민주당에 촉구하는 것이 대통령이 해야 할 일”이라고 말했다.)

Candidate Yoo Jeong-bok said, "This meeting must not be a one-time event. Metropolitan area opposition candidates should form a front to defend the rule of law through joint statements and schedules." The Reform Party indicated it is open to continued joint action with the People Power Party. Leader Lee Jun-seok told reporters, "If People Power Party leader Jang Dong-hyuk wants to discuss party-level strategies with the Reform Party, I am willing to have a dialogue." Separately, the People Power Party has also escalated its offensive. (유정복 후보는 “만남이 일회성으로 끝나면 안 된다. 수도권 야권 후보들이 공동 성명과 일정을 통해 법치주의 수호 전선을 만들어야 한다”고 말했다. 개혁신당은 향후 국민의힘과 공동 대응을 이어갈 용의가 있다고 했다. 이준석 대표는 기자들에게 “국민의힘 장동혁 대표가 당 차원 투쟁 방안을 개혁신당과 논의하겠다면 대화할 생각이 있다”고 말했다. 이와는 별도로 국민의힘도 공세 수위를 높였다.)

On the same day, Leader Jang Dong-hyuk criticized on Facebook President Lee's remark that "the ruling Democratic Party should decide on specific timing and procedures through gathering public opinion and deliberation" regarding the Fabricated Indictment Special Counsel Act, saying, "This is an admission that it is a 'Lee Jae-myung-ordered legislation.' Lee commits the crime, and the party does the cleanup—the division of labor is exactly 'gangster style.'" People Power Party Busan mayoral candidate Park Hyung-joon and other People Power Party-affiliated candidates for the five metropolitan mayoral positions in the Yeongnam region are also planning to hold an emergency press conference on the 6th to denounce the Fabricated Indictment Special Counsel Act. (장동혁 대표도 이날 페이스북에 이 대통령이 조작기소 특검법에 대해 “구체적인 시기와 절차에 대해서는 여당인 민주당이 국민적 의견 수렴과 숙의 과정을 거쳐서 판단해달라”고 한 것에 대해 “‘이재명 하명 입법’임을 자백한 것이다. 죄는 이재명이 짓고, 설거지는 당에서 하고, 업무 분담이 딱 ‘조폭 스타일’”이라고 비판했다. 박형준 국민의힘 부산시장 후보 등 국민의힘 소속 영남 5개 광역단체장 후보들도 오는 6일 조작기소 특검법을 규탄하는 긴급 기자회견을 할 예정이다.)

Reporter Yoo Young-jae young@hani.co.kr (유영재 기자 young@hani.co.kr)
